description: Puts the latest code on a live project's branch online: pulls it and restarts the app, like Pull & Restart in The Deployer. It changes a live app, so confirm with the user first. Only for a project that's already live; a project's first deployment starts in the app. Takes a few minutes; follow it with status or logs. Needs an API key.

project.description: The live project's id, name or repository. Optional with one project.

name: redeploy
title: Redeploy a live project
